review.decision: Exercise no-submit, unknown and confirmed results at separate transport and caller boundaries.
review.notes: P1.2 on f14bc6a2. Review preserves state strings, wait evidence prefixes, native hold and replay gates. Assertions use private HOME and fake terminal I/O or a fake tmux binary. No independent approval or execution is claimed.

cases.description: Shared dispatch preserves a typed transport failure and the known submission boundary.
cases.setup: Injected paste, Enter, hold and native outcomes with invocation counters.
cases.action: Refuse on a typed paste error, stop at a fragment or hold, pass a known pre-Enter rejection or an unconfirmed Enter, and observe native admission versus a possible mutation.
cases.expected: Before-submit refusal does not make an Enter call. A potentially attempted send is unknown with its original attempt count. Draft holds retain their evidence prefixes. Success, native precedence and the legacy bool wrapper are retained.

cases.description: CLI and HTTP present the same failure class without reporting acceptance or promising a retry.
cases.setup: Real CLI argument handling and HTTP handler with isolated terminal attachment, fake I/O and no live session.
cases.action: Exercise CLI verified and no-verify text submission, HTTP text submission with a stable send ID, capacity, invalid layout, target change, unknown outcome and a successful send.
cases.expected: Failures exit nonzero or fail the HTTP request. Stable codes identify the failure and optional submission status; the HTTP error carries the caller ID and no draft, payload, capture or success receipt. Unknown is not success-cached. Successful requests keep their receipt and caching. A native question is reported only with evidence.
